info.title: nvidia/gds/v1/common.proto
info.description:
The Global Discovery Service (GDS) API.

The API is additive only; a breaking change means a new v2 package. Every
RPC is served over gRPC and mirrored as REST/JSON through the
google.api.http annotations. JSON follows the proto3 JSON mapping
(lowerCamelCase field names, enums as strings, 64-bit integers as strings).
Server streams are rendered as newline-delimited JSON objects of the form
{"result": {...}}.

Errors are google.rpc.Status values carrying a google.rpc.ErrorInfo with
domain "gds.nvidia.com" and one of these reasons:

  STALE_GENERATION        FAILED_PRECONDITION. The write carried a
                          generation that does not exceed the stored one.
                          ErrorInfo.metadata["current_generation"] holds the
                          stored generation; a PreconditionFailure detail
                          repeats it.
  LEASE_EPOCH_MISMATCH    ABORTED. A heartbeat carried an epoch other than
                          the current lease epoch. Register again.
  CLUSTER_NOT_REGISTERED  FAILED_PRECONDITION or NOT_FOUND. The cluster has
                          no registration in the clusterset.
  POOL_NAME_TAKEN         ALREADY_EXISTS. Another pool already uses the name
                          in (clusterset, cluster).
  TOO_MANY_ENDPOINTS      INVALID_ARGUMENT. An endpoint set exceeds 1000
                          endpoints.
  TOO_MANY_WATCHERS       RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. The replica serves
                          --max-watchers streams already.
  STORE_UNAVAILABLE       UNAVAILABLE. The backing store did not answer.
                          Retry with backoff.
  SHUTTING_DOWN           UNAVAILABLE. The replica is draining. Reconnect;
                          another replica serves the request.

Invalid input is INVALID_ARGUMENT with a google.rpc.BadRequest detail.

Limits: identifiers (clusterset, cluster, namespace, name, pool name) are
DNS-1123 labels; 64 labels; 32 annotations totalling at most 16 KiB; 64
ports; 1000 endpoints per export per cluster; 16 attributes per endpoint;
256 models per pool; 4 MiB per message.

get.summary: ListClusterSets returns every known clusterset with object counts.
ListClusters returns the clusters of a clusterset.

parameters.name: includeExpired
parameters.description: Include clusters whose lease has expired but whose records are retained.

get.summary: GetCluster returns one cluster with its lease evaluated now.

delete.summary:
DeregisterCluster removes the cluster and cascades to its exports,
endpoint sets and pools. Deleting an unknown cluster succeeds.

put.summary:
RegisterCluster creates or replaces the registration of a cluster and
mints a new lease epoch. It is idempotent: a restarted controller
registers again and keeps its exports. lease_ttl is clamped to
[10 s, 5 m] and defaults to 30 s.

get.summary:
ListServiceExports returns the exports of one cluster, for controller
resync after a restart or reconnect.

delete.summary:
DeleteServiceExport removes the export and its endpoint set. Deleting an
unknown export succeeds.

put.summary:
PutServiceExport creates or replaces the export of a Service from one
cluster. generation must exceed the stored one; otherwise the call fails
with FAILED_PRECONDITION and reason STALE_GENERATION.

ReplaceEndpoints replaces the full endpoint set of an export. It is the
only endpoint write: idempotent across restarts and free of tombstones.
generation must exceed the stored one; a stale write fails with
FAILED_PRECONDITION, reason STALE_GENERATION and the current generation.
At most 1000 endpoints per export per cluster (TOO_MANY_ENDPOINTS).

get.summary:
WatchClusters streams the clusters of a clusterset: a snapshot, then
deltas and bookmarks. See EventType.

parameters.name: resumeRevision
parameters.description: Revision from a previous SNAPSHOT_END, BOOKMARK or delta.

get.summary: ListServiceImports returns the merged imports of a clusterset.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Only imports in this namespace; all namespaces when empty.

get.summary:
WatchServiceImports streams the merged imports of a clusterset: a
snapshot, then deltas and bookmarks. See EventType.

parameters.name: resumeRevision
parameters.description: Revision from a previous SNAPSHOT_END, BOOKMARK or delta.

get.summary: ListPools returns the pools of a clusterset that match every filter set.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Matches a model_id or an alias.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description:
Matches any of the listed derived states; all states except GONE when
empty.

post.summary:
RegisterPool registers a pool or re-registers it. It is idempotent on
(cluster, name): the existing pool_id is returned and a new lease epoch
is minted. The server assigns pool_id unless the request names one; a
pool_id that differs from the pool already holding the name fails with
ALREADY_EXISTS and reason POOL_NAME_TAKEN.

delete.summary:
DeregisterPool removes the API registration. Watchers receive a DELETE
event with state GONE. Deregistering an unknown pool succeeds.

patch.summary:
UpdatePool changes the writer-owned fields named in update_mask.
generation must exceed the stored one (STALE_GENERATION).

post.summary:
HeartbeatPool renews the pool lease and optionally reports worker counts
and the desired state. The epoch must be the current one
(LEASE_EPOCH_MISMATCH). API pools heartbeat every 20 s by default.

get.summary:
WatchPools streams the matching pools: a snapshot, then deltas and
bookmarks. See EventType.

parameters.name: resumeRevision
parameters.description: Revision from a previous SNAPSHOT_END, BOOKMARK or delta.

get.summary:
ListRouters returns the routers derived from exports labelled
gds.nvidia.com/role=router.

WatchRouters streams the matching routers: a snapshot, then deltas and
bookmarks. See EventType.

parameters.name: resumeRevision
parameters.description: Revision from a previous SNAPSHOT_END, BOOKMARK or delta.

get.summary:
GetServerInfo returns the replica's region, version and view epoch, and
the GDS endpoints of every region from --advertise-endpoints. Clients try
those endpoints after their configured URLs.

epoch.description: The lease epoch returned by RegisterCluster.

leaseTtl.description: Requested lease duration; clamped to [10 s, 5 m]; 30 s when unset.

epoch.description: The lease epoch returned by RegisterPool.

workerCount.description: Optional worker counts; unchanged when unset.

desiredState.description: ACTIVE or DRAINING; unchanged when UNSPECIFIED.

pool.description:
Writer-owned fields: pool_id (optional), name, location, hardware_class,
models, worker_count, ready_worker_count, frontends, services, labels,
desired_state and owner_id. Server-owned fields are ignored.

leaseTtl.description: Pool lease duration; clamped to [10 s, 5 m]; 60 s when unset.

pool.description: New values of the fields named in update_mask.

updateMask.description:
Writer-owned Pool field paths, for example worker_count or
desired_state. An empty mask replaces every writer-owned field.

endpoints.description: The full endpoint set; an empty list clears it.

dc.description: Data center, from the gds.nvidia.com/dc annotation or the API.

cluster.description: Cluster id of the pool; required.

v1AddressType.description: AddressType is the EndpointSlice address type.

zones.description: Availability zones of the cluster's nodes.

provider.description: Free-form provider name, for example eks or k3d.

agentId.description: Identity of the registering agent, for example the controller pod name.

generation.description: Incremented by the server on every registration.

registeredAt.description: Time of the first registration; kept across re-registrations.

v1Cluster.description: Cluster is the registration of a member cluster.

generation.description: Writer generation of the endpoint set.

namespace.description:
Namespace and name of the exported Service. Set in Pool.endpoints, where
several Services of one cluster contribute; empty in ServiceImport.

v1ClusterEndpoints.description:
ClusterEndpoints is the endpoint set that one source cluster contributes to
an import, or that one Service contributes to a pool. Counts are always
set; endpoints is filled only when the request asked for endpoints.

participating.description:
False when the cluster's lease has expired; its endpoints are then
excluded and its export does not take part in conflict resolution.

conflict.description: Set when this cluster's export disagrees with the winning export.

conditions.description:
Conditions the controller of this cluster copies onto its ServiceExport
(Ready, Conflict).

v1ClusterStatus.description: ClusterStatus is the per-source-cluster status of an import.

v1Condition.description:
Condition mirrors metav1.Condition. Types and reasons follow sigs.k8s.io/mcs-api
(Valid, Ready, Conflict; NoConflicts, PortConflict, TypeConflict,
SessionAffinityConflict, SessionAffinityConfigConflict, AnnotationsConflict,
LabelsConflict, InternalTrafficPolicyConflict, TrafficDistributionConflict)
plus IPFamilyConflict and ClusterLeaseExpired.

v1ConditionStatus.description: ConditionStatus mirrors the Kubernetes condition status.

reason.description: A Conflict condition reason, for example PortConflict.

winningCluster.description: Cluster whose export won (the oldest export with an active lease).

v1Conflict.description: Conflict reports a disagreement between exports of one Service.

v1EndpointConditions.description: EndpointConditions mirrors the EndpointSlice endpoint conditions.

v1EventType.description:
EventType is the kind of a watch event.

A watch sends SNAPSHOT_START, one UPSERT per object, SNAPSHOT_END with the
revision, then UPSERT and DELETE deltas, and a BOOKMARK every 5 s. A watch
opened with a usable resume_revision skips the snapshot and receives only
the deltas after that revision; an unknown or stale revision yields a new
snapshot, never an error. A slow watcher is re-snapshotted, not
disconnected.

 - EVENT_TYPE_SNAPSHOT_START: Start of a full snapshot. Clients discard their local state.
 - EVENT_TYPE_UPSERT: The object was created or changed; it carries the full object.
 - EVENT_TYPE_DELETE: The object was removed; it carries the last known object.
 - EVENT_TYPE_SNAPSHOT_END: End of a full snapshot; revision is set.
 - EVENT_TYPE_BOOKMARK: Keepalive carrying the current revision; no object.

url.description: Static URL, for pools fronted by a load balancer.

service.description: Exported Service in the pool's cluster.

portName.description:
Service port to dial; defaults to the gds.nvidia.com/http-port-name
annotation, then http.

v1FrontendEndpoint.description:
FrontendEndpoint is a dialable entry point of a pool. Exactly one of url
and service is set. A client resolves service to the derived Service of the
import in its own cluster:
derived-<hash>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local, with the port named
port_name.

v1FrontendRole.description:
FrontendRole is what a pool endpoint or Service serves.

 - FRONTEND_ROLE_OPENAI: OpenAI-compatible HTTP frontend; the dispatch address for routers.
Label role pool-frontend.
 - FRONTEND_ROLE_KV_RELAY: KV event relay (Dynamo PoolRelay). Label role kv-relay.

viewEpoch.description:
Epoch of this replica's view. Revisions from another view epoch are not
resumable on this replica.

v1IPFamily.description: IPFamily is a Kubernetes IP family.

v1InternalTrafficPolicy.description: InternalTrafficPolicy is the Kubernetes Service internal traffic policy.

v1LabelSelector.description: LabelSelector selects objects whose labels contain every entry.

epoch.description:
Incarnation number minted by the server on every registration as
max(previous + 1, unix milliseconds). Heartbeats must carry it.

renewedAt.description: Server time of the last registration or heartbeat.

v1Lease.description:
Lease is a server-assigned liveness lease of a cluster or of an
API-registered pool. Nothing writes expiry to the store; state is computed
from renewed_at, ttl and the server clock when the object is read.

v1LeaseState.description:
LeaseState is the state of a lease evaluated at read time.

 - LEASE_STATE_ACTIVE: The lease was renewed within ttl plus the skew allowance.
 - LEASE_STATE_EXPIRED: The lease is past expires_at plus the skew allowance.

revision.description: Revision of the view the list was taken from; usable as resume_revision.
Revision of the view the list was taken from; usable as resume_revision.
Revision of the view the list was taken from; usable as resume_revision.
Revision of the view the list was taken from; usable as resume_revision.

v1ModelServed.description: ModelServed is a model a pool serves.

poolId.description:
Server-assigned UUID unless given at registration; stable for the pool's
life.

hardwareClass.description: Free-form hardware class, for example b200-ib.

frontends.description:
Dispatch entries. Always contains the OPENAI entry: the exported
frontend Service for label-derived pools, the caller's url for API pools.

services.description: Exported Services in the pool's cluster used for the endpoint join.

desiredState.description: ACTIVE or DRAINING; set through the API overlay.

lease.description: Lease of an API registration; unset for label-only pools.

generation.description: Writer generation of the API registration.

endpoints.description:
Endpoints joined from the imports of the pool's Services in
location.cluster, one entry per Service. Counts are always set; the
endpoint lists only when include_endpoints is requested.

readyEndpointCount.description:
Ready endpoints across the pool's OPENAI frontend Services. Routers skip
pools with none.

v1Pool.description: Pool is the unit of routing, nominally one Dynamo graph deployment.

v1PoolState.description:
PoolState is the desired or derived state of a pool.

Derivation: REGISTERED until the first heartbeat (API-only pools) or the
first ready endpoint (pools joined to exports); then desired_state (ACTIVE
or DRAINING) while the pool is live, UNHEALTHY otherwise. A pool joined to
exports is live while its cluster lease is active and at least one of its
endpoints is ready; an API-only pool (no services and no labelled export) is
live while its own lease is active. GONE after DeregisterPool or when both
the labelled export and the API registration are gone; a GONE pool is kept
as a tombstone for one bookmark interval.

v1Protocol.description: Protocol is a Kubernetes port protocol.

cluster.description: The stored registration with the newly minted lease.

pool.description: The stored pool with its pool_id and newly minted lease.

grpcPort.description: Port named by gds.nvidia.com/grpc-port-name (default grpc); 0 if absent.

httpPort.description: Port named by gds.nvidia.com/http-port-name (default http); 0 if absent.

v1Router.description:
Router is derived from one export labelled gds.nvidia.com/role=router, one
per (cluster, namespace, name). A pylon dials the derived Service of the
import in its own cluster:
<dial_scheme>://derived-<hash>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:<grpc_port>.

v1RouterReplica.description: RouterReplica is one endpoint of a router Service.

primary.description: True for the global entry clients should prefer.

v1ServerEndpoint.description: ServerEndpoint is the address of the GDS service in one region.

endpointsGeneration.description: Writer generation of the endpoint set; 0 when none was written.

v1ServiceExport.description: ServiceExport is the stored export of a Service from one cluster.

annotations.description:
Exported annotations: spec.exportedAnnotations of the ServiceExport plus
the Service's gds.nvidia.com/* annotations.

labels.description:
Exported labels: spec.exportedLabels of the ServiceExport plus the
Service's gds.nvidia.com/* labels.

exportCreationTimestamp.description: creationTimestamp of the ServiceExport; the oldest export wins conflicts.

v1ServiceExportSpec.description:
ServiceExportSpec is the exported shape of a Service, the record Cilium
calls MCSAPIServiceSpec. The controller fills it from the Service and the
ServiceExport.

ports.description: Union of the participating exports' ports by (port, protocol).

ipFamilies.description: Intersection of the participating exports' IP families.

annotations.description: Exported annotations and labels of the winning export.

conflict.description: Set when any participating export conflicts with the winner.

endpoints.description: Endpoints grouped by source cluster, including the importing cluster.

v1ServiceImport.description:
ServiceImport is the merged, clusterset-wide view of an exported Service.
It is computed, never stored.

v1ServicePort.description: ServicePort is a port of an exported Service.

v1ServiceRef.description: ServiceRef names an exported Service in the pool's cluster.

v1ServiceType.description:
ServiceType is the KEP-1645 ServiceImport type.

 - SERVICE_TYPE_CLUSTER_SET_IP: One virtual IP per importing cluster (the Service has a cluster IP).
 - SERVICE_TYPE_HEADLESS: No virtual IP; per-endpoint records (the Service has clusterIP: None).

v1SessionAffinity.description: SessionAffinity is the Kubernetes Service session affinity.

revision.description: Set for SNAPSHOT_END, BOOKMARK and every delta.

pool.description: Set for UPSERT and DELETE. A DELETE carries state GONE.
